mapper.select: SELECT FROM git_credentials WHERE legacy_repo_id IS NULL AND created_by=#{actorId} ORDER BY (status='ACTIVE') DESC, updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE git_credentials SET status=#{status},disabled_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='DISABLED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repository_credential_bindings WHERE credential_id=#{id}
SELECT c.* FROM repository_credential_bindings b JOIN git_credentials c ON c.id=b.credential_id WHERE b.repository_id=#{repositoryId} AND b.usage_type='CLONE'

SELECT r.id repository_id,r.name repository_name,b.usage_type,b.created_at FROM repository_credential_bindings b JOIN repositories r ON r.id=b.repository_id WHERE b.credential_id=#{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repository_credential_bindings(repository_id,credential_id,usage_type,bound_by) VALUES(#{repositoryId},#{credentialId},'CLONE',#{actorId}) ON CONFLICT(repository_id,usage_type) DO UPDATE SET credential_id=EXCLUDED.credential_id, bound_by=EXCLUDED.bound_by,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM repository_credential_bindings WHERE repository_id=#{repositoryId} AND usage_type='CLONE'
